bio.text: Rudy Recile is the Republican candidate for California's 8th Congressional District in 2026.
Born in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, Recile served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 2014 and retired as a major, according to the candidate statement.
The candidate earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Illinois University in 1995 and a graduate degree from National Graduate School in 2005.
The statement says Recile is a former U.S. Department of Agriculture employee and owner of a small web design company, and that the family has lived in Solano County for 18 years.
